formal_object.rationale: Source and target surface areas a_i,b_j>0, equal total mass; correspondence costs c_ij from permitted features; epsilon>0. The stated object/domain, rather than the official unsquared Chamfer, is the object of this conditional derivation.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: A03: Counting vertices versus integrating surface area -> Use physical surface mass instead of vertex density; condition: Areas are computed from released/model meshes, not hidden labels; D01: Entropic transport with row and column constraints -> KKT scaling form; condition: Finite costs and compatible positive marginals; D02: Distributional transport optimum -> Normalized coupled assignment; condition: Positive kernel and feasible support All current edges remain conditional where model/data availability is not established.

derivation.rationale: Differentiating positive entropic transport gives log Pi=-(c+alpha+beta)/epsilon and the uKv form with both marginals. The finite scaling witness closes row and column sums. Equal total mass, support feasibility and area assumptions are indispensable; legitimate stretching can invalidate area-preserving correspondence.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: True correspondence does not necessarily preserve model-surface area; this assumption can fail under real stretch or shape error.; Source/target surface samples and legal features must actually be available.; Zero-area elements are removed with a retained mapping, not hidden from evaluation.; Sparse support must admit a feasible transport plan. These are obligations, not observations about ActionBench.

method_expression.rationale: Use area-marginal entropic assignment, obtain per-source targets from normalized transported mass, and use the same lift as controls. The reviewed construction is Continuous globally mass-balanced correspondence coupling.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: Area constraints should prevent many source regions collapsing onto the same favored target; they can hurt when the target mass model is wrong. It can be rejected by: Reject if balancing consistently harms native motion under realistic area change, or row-only matching plus the same geometric lift is adequate. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.

closest_alternative.rationale: Named alternatives: Classical Sinkhorn OT; STAC row-normalized correspondence; Catalyst4D's OT anchors need full collision inspection. Claimed operational difference: The global column mass constraint differs structurally from C05's discrete mode coherence; OT itself is existing work. This check verifies an explicit comparator and conditional delta, not completed novelty clearance.
